name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/runeterra.md, The game's rules (from sources): the player on attack acts first; attackers fight blockers; an attacker that is not blocked strikes the opponent's Nexus (Riot round FAQ).

name: Game rule: unspent mana is kept as spell mana
source: https://support.riotgames.com/en-us/legends-of-runeterra/gameplay/let-s-talk-about-mana (up to 3 unused mana is banked at the end of a round as spell mana, for spell cards only)
